q: Chemical reactions occur when you breathe, eat, or just sit there ____.
e: Chemical reactions occur when you breathe, eat, or just sit there reading. Reading is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The air you are breathing is a mixture of elements like ____ and nitrogen.
e: The air you are breathing is a mixture of elements like oxygen and nitrogen. Oxygen supports respiration and combustion, and it is a very reactive non-metal.

q: The book you are reading is made from wood pulp or ____ which has been bleached and treated with various chemicals.
e: The book you are reading is made from wood pulp or cellulose which has been bleached and treated with various chemicals. Cellulose is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The clothes you are wearing are probably made from synthetic chemicals called ____, such as nylon or terylene.
e: The clothes you are wearing are probably made from synthetic chemicals called polymers, such as nylon or terylene. Polymers is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The seat you are sitting on is perhaps a plastic polymer, with ____; foam seat padding and metal support.
e: The seat you are sitting on is perhaps a plastic polymer, with polyurethane; foam seat padding and metal support. Polyurethane is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The room you are in is made from cement, plastics, concrete and ____, all of which are chemicals.
e: The room you are in is made from cement, plastics, concrete and glass, all of which are chemicals. Making glass from sand and alkali is an early industrial chemical change.
Some chemicals are toxic. Toxic is the idea that completes this fact.

q: All matter is made of chemicals, so the importance of chemistry is that it is the study of ____.
e: All matter is made of chemicals, so the importance of chemistry is that it is the study of everything. Everything is the idea that completes this fact.
